note.zh-TW: 教材與中文介面顯示「預收收入」，現行 IFRS 15 的科目名稱是合約負債（列在現行用語）；英文介面直接用 IFRS 15 的 contract liabilities。網站補充的延伸科目。
note.en: The course and the Chinese interface show 預收收入 (unearned revenue), with the current IFRS 15 name 合約負債 listed as the current term; in English the site uses the IFRS 15 term, contract liabilities, and keeps unearned revenue as an alias. An extension account added by the site.

definition.zh-TW: 客戶先付了錢、公司還沒交貨或提供服務的部分。它是負債，因為公司還欠客戶履約；等到交貨時才轉成收入。
definition.en: Money received from customers before the goods or services have been delivered. It is a liability because the business still owes performance, and it becomes revenue when delivery happens.
